---
title: "Hello with quarto-gradio"

filters:
  - gradio

execute:
  enabled: false
---

This app runs in the reader's browser after Quarto renders the page. It does not need a Python application server after publishing.

For more detailed examples, please refer to the [live docs](https://quarto-gradio.peter.gy).

```{python}
import gradio as gr

def greet(name):
    return f"Hello {name}!"

demo = gr.Interface(
    fn=greet, 
    inputs="textbox", 
    outputs="textbox", 
    live=True,
    flagging_mode="never",
)

demo.launch()
```
